scripts.install:all: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir tooling/dshx install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --dir plugins install --frozen-lockfile && ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 pnpm --dir apps/desktop install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-workspace && pnpm run setup:browser
